To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we proposed a novel three-dimensional vertical floating gate nand Flash memory using the separated-side-wall control gate (S-SCGs), which can fully suppress the interference effects and disturbance problems at the cell string, and can achieve the highest CG coupling ratios and low-voltage cell operation.
the proposed S-Scg nand Flash cell has the potential to be a key technology for the terabit 3D vertical Flash memory cell array.

the proposed cell has the following advantages: (1) it is the first 3-D FG-type nand cell with a line-type CG structure; (2) it can suppress the disturbance problems by the direct coupling effects; (3) it is the simplest cell structure for the 3-D vertical cell array; and (4) it can realize the lowest program/erase voltages among the recent 3D vertical cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the novel 3-D FG-type nand Flash cell using the S-SCG.
the development of the novel cell structure and the process integration of 3-D nand Flash memory.
the development of a novel 3D FG nand Flash memory using the S-SCG structure.

the proposed S-Scg cell is an ideal 3-D vertical cell for the next-generation terabit Flash memory.
the proposed 3-D vertical FG nand cell array is the best candidate for the terabit nand Flash memory with multilevel cell operations.

the proposed S- SCG structure is a novel and effective solution for the recent problems of 3-D vertical cell structures, such as the interference effect, disturbance effect, and the direct coupling effect.
